name: The Brood of Onyxia
summary: At Brackenwall Village, The Brood of Onyxia meets Overlord Mok'Morokk's denial. He says no black dragons are here and sends you back to Draz'Zilb with word that the ogres will stay.

sections.title: Leave Me Alone
sections.body: Overlord Mok'Morokk wants to be left alone after Draz'Zilb reports the brood of Onyxia. He says the ogres will stay where they are and denies that any black dragon is here. Carry his answer to Draz'Zilb in Brackenwall Village.

sections.title: What Draz'Zilb Says
sections.body: Draz'Zilb calls Overlord Mok'Morokk a lazy coward and says something must be done. Mok'Morokk showed strength while Rexxar led the ogres. After Rexxar departed, power tempted him. Now Mok'Morokk demands service from the ogres instead of leading them.

faq.q: Why does Overlord Mok'Morokk refuse to act?
faq.answer: Overlord Mok'Morokk refuses to act because he says there are no black dragons here and wants to be left alone. He sends you to tell Draz'Zilb that the ogres will stay.

faq.q: What comes before this in the storyline?
faq.answer: This follows the earlier account of The Brood of Onyxia, when Draz'Zilb sent you to bring word of the brood to Mok'Morokk.
Overlord Mok'Morokk and Draz'Zilb are both in Brackenwall Village.
